questions.stem: Which of the following is false regarding a disaster?

options.label: A
options.text: Occurrence that causes damage to life and property

options.label: B
options.text: Occurrence that has the potential to cause disruption or damage to people

options.label: C
options.text: Occurrence that causes deterioration of health and health services

options.label: D
options.text: Occurrence that can cause substantial economic harm
